items.title: Gulati: We Are Woefully Under-Invested in AI Security
items.summary: Sheila Gulati, Founder and Managing Director of Total Capital and a former leader of Microsoft's Azure business, discusses rising warnings from Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, and others about the AI sector. The segment frames the conversation around whether those warnings should be taken seriously and how they relate to broader concerns about AI oversight. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Bailey Lipschultz on "The Close."
